page: Microsoft Azure E16ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Eadv6 server family. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, running at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The instance features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. A 945 GB local storage disk is bundled with the instance, which is also Premium Storage capable.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-core capabilities, with both stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core scores ranking in the top 25%. Text processing is a notable strength, placing in the top 10% of Geekbench tests. Multi-core performance, including Geekbench multi-core and stress-ng multi-core, falls within the average range. Memory bandwidth tests show average performance for small block reads and large block writes, though large block read-only bandwidth is relatively weak, placing in the bottom 25%.

This server configuration is well-suited for memory-intensive workloads, database operations, and text processing tasks. The inclusion of a 945 GB local disk and Premium Storage capability supports data-heavy applications and caching layers. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density per vCPU provides a balanced resource profile for enterprise databases and mid-sized analytical workloads without the overhead of higher vCPU tiers.
